Hi Ellie / Marco,

Putting Marissa (Implementation lead) and Ben (Onboarding eng) on this thread to kick off the tenant activation and initial API key seeding for StreamlineHealth. Attached: Streamline_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx and scoping-notes.pdf.

High-level asks to unblock the kickoff:
- Confirm primary org admin(s) (name + email) who will accept invites and rotate keys.
- Preferred project/namespace you'd like us to create (we can default to 'streamline-health-prod').
- KMS/keys: are you using customer-managed KMS or should we provision Redwood-managed keys?
- SSO: will you want Okta SSO configured at activation? If yes, share IdP metadata or SAML contact.

Marissa will propose a short kickoff window and a 2-week implementation sprint. Please let us know availability and the admin list.

Thanks,

Aditya Rao

Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — looping in the implementation team.

Hi Ellie / Marco,

Nice to meet you. Proposed plan:
1) Pre-work (this week): share admin list + project name + SSO/KMS decision.
2) Kickoff (30–45 min): demo admin flow, share runbook, confirm invite acceptance.
3) Week 1: API key seeding and service account creation; validate token rotations.
4) Week 2: Sandboxed calls, traffic routing, and open items (monitoring, alerts).

Pre-work checklist (what we'll need before kickoff):
- Admin emails (for invite + role assignment)
- Preferred project name
- Service account owner email (for seeding)
- If SSO: IdP metadata XML or SAML redirect URL
- Any IP allowlist ranges (if you use a VPC or dedicated)

Proposed kickoff windows (PDT): Tue 2027-05-25 09:00–09:45 or Wed 2027-05-26 14:00–14:45. Tell us what works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Ben, Monica — I'll take lead on the runbook and service-account seeding. I'll mark the mutual action plan with the timeline.

On quoting Aditya's note: 'we can default to 'streamline-health-prod'' — if Streamline prefers another namespace, now's the time.

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
